pr_title: Upgrade tplink with new platforms, features and device support
pr_body:
<!--
  You are amazing! Thanks for contributing to our project!
  Please, DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! (unless instructed).
-->
## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important
  to tell them what breaks, how to make it work again and why we did this.
  This piece of text is published with the release notes, so it helps if you
  write it towards our users, not us.
  Note: Remove this section if this PR is NOT a breaking change.
-->
"Total power usage" is removed from devices which never really supported it, but the sensor was reporting the daily consumption.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

This PR modernizes the tplink integration to leverage upstream-provided information about available device features for much more polished user experience and creates the foundation for future extensions.
In addition to exposing new features using the newly added platforms, this also adds support for new devices like hubs and devices paired with them (thermostats, temperature/humidity sensors, water leak sensors, contact sensors) and fan-dimmer KS240.

New features and improvements include:
* Support for light effects, light presets & configuring smooth transitions on supported devices
* Showing entities for cloud connectivity, firmware updates and allow configuration auto updates
* Device-dependent information about device state such as signal strength and on since time
* And many more improvements!

New platforms:
* number
* binary_sensor
* select
* button
* climate
* fan

Upstream changelog(s): https://github.com/python-kasa/python-kasa/releases/tag/0.7.0 https://github.com/python-kasa/python-kasa/releases/tag/0.7.0.1
https://github.com/python-kasa/python-kasa/compare/0.6.2.1...0.7.0.1

Thanks for the report @scheelj! This device acts quite differently than other devices (it's practically two sub-devices with different functions), but we are working on to get it supported: https://github.com/python-kasa/python-kasa/pull/764 - the current plan is to get this done for 2024.4 (so the release after the upcoming one), if you want to follow the process, you can subscribe for notifications of the linked PR.

Not critical for this PR but presumably this could go in:
```py
    async def async_added_to_hass(self) -> None:
        """Handle being added to hass."""
        self._attr_native_min_value = self._feature.minimum_value
        self._attr_native_max_value = self._feature.maximum_value
        return await super().async_added_to_hass()
```
And be able to drop the constructor?

I noted elsewhere that similar approach did not work for `select` as it its `options` were accessed by homeassistant internals prior the `async_added_to_hass` was called. I think we could keep it as it is for now, as we will need to revisit this afterwards if and when we have entities with changing constraints.
Done in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/120404

Not critical for this pr but this should probably go in `_async_update_attrs` and we can drop the constructor.  Although the library doesn't currently support indirection for `choices` it should in the future (same for `units`) so it can handle updates to the underlying choices.

We will revisit this when we are that far, see the above comment. I haven't looked at the internal code, but I'd guess that it will be more performant when it's not being set on every update cycle :+1:
